title: UCB CS186: Introduction to Database System

unit.title: Contract-Driven Relational Operator Pipeline
unit.audience: A strong algorithms student developing production-oriented software-engineering habits

in_scope: A typed in-memory row and schema model
Composable scan, filter, project, and limit operators
Explicit operator lifecycle and error contracts
Deterministic unit, integration, and fixed-seed generated tests
out_of_scope: Any claim of completing the catalog course

learning_objectives: Translate relational behavior into precise component contracts
Separate data-model, execution, lifecycle, and validation responsibilities
Implement a small composable Java subsystem with deterministic behavior
Test boundary conditions, misuse, composition, and ownership rather than only happy paths
Record reproducible commands, provenance, and validation state

unit_completion_requires: All required learner artifacts are present in the submitted attempt workspace
The harness independently executes the documented build and test commands with bounded resources
The implementation passes evaluator-controlled semantic and lifecycle checks
The examiner applies examiner_only/RUBRIC.md and records a passing result
Validation logs are attributable to the submitted artifact revision
completion_policy.course_completion_note: This manifest prepares and may validate one manager-authored kickoff only. Later units require separately sourced, classified, prepared, and harness-validated records.

preparation.validation_scope: Artifact structure, JSON syntax, cross-file identifiers, audience separation, and kickoff boundary only
